claims.claim: MEMENTO raises Qwen3-8B accuracy from 36.9% to 67.8% on book-level QA with books up to 2.5M tokens while never holding more than 20K tokens in context.
claims.episode_span: On book-level QA with inputs up to 2.5M tokens it lifts base Qwen3-8B accuracy from 36.9% to 67.8%, beating a GPT-5.5 agent (13.1%) at less than 1/50 the cost and nearly matching a 100× larger GLM-5.3 agent at 1/9 the cost.
claims.source_title: MEMENTO: Learning Context Management for Long Context Processing Agents
claims.supporting_quote: On book-level question answering across four benchmarks, with books of up to 2.5M tokens, MEMENTO raises Qwen3-8B's accuracy from 36.9% to 67.8% while never holding more than 20K tokens in context.

claims.claim: All 11 commercial humanizers altered or dropped at least one checkable unit in 35-65% of documents containing them.
claims.episode_span: All 11 commercial humanizers on an October 2026 public leaderboard altered or dropped at least one checkable unit (numbers, dates, names, quoted spans) in 35-65% of documents containing them.
claims.source_title: Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers
claims.supporting_quote: In the October 2026 cycle of a public humanizer leaderboard, all 11 commercial tools changed or dropped at least one of these units in 35-65% of the documents that contained one.

claims.claim: CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% to 46.8% and F1 from 23.0% to 49.4% for MedGemma-4B on a 4,145-image held-out split.
claims.episode_span: On a 4,145-image held-out split it lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% to 46.8% and F1 from 23.0% to 49.4% for MedGemma-4B; similar absolute gains appear on LLaVA-Med and MAIRA-2.
claims.source_title: CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports
claims.supporting_quote: On a 4,145-image held-out split, CheXPoT yields statistically significant precision gains on 8 of 14 CheXpert classes and F1 gains on 5, with no significant decreases in either metric. CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% (MedGemma-4B) to 46.8% (MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT) and micro-average F1 from 23.0% to 49.4%, absolute gains of 27.6% and 26.4% respectively.

claims.claim: The 560M model, trained on 235k synthetic Tajik question-passage pairs plus English and Russian negatives, raises top-10 recall on unseen law text from 80.2% to 93.6% and on tax documents from 82.6% to 94.5%.
claims.episode_span: The 560M model, trained on 235k synthetic Tajik question-passage pairs plus English and Russian negatives, raises top-10 recall on unseen law text from 80.2% to 93.6% and on tax documents from 82.6% to 94.5%.
claims.supporting_quote: On laws the model had never seen, the right passage is among the top ten results for 93.6% of questions, up from 80.2%; on tax documents, 94.5% against 82.6%
